spans.s: शेष [śēṣa], a. [शिष्-अच्] Remaining, rest, all the other; न्यषेधि शेषो$प्यनुयायिवर्गः
; शेषान् मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा
; oft. at the end of comp. in this sense; भक्षितशेष, आलेख्यशेष &c.
षः, षम् (a) Remainder, rest, residue; ऋणशेषो$ग्निशेषश्च व्याधिशेषस्तथैव च । पुनश्च वर्धते यस्मात्तस्माच्छेषं न कारयेत् ॥ Chāṇ 4; अध्वशेष
; प्रतिकारविधानमायुषः सति शेषे हि फलाय कल्पते
Anything left out or omitted to be said; (
is often used by commentators in supplying an ellipsis or words necessary to complete the construction).

N. of a celebrated serpent, said to have one thousand heads, and represented as forming the couch of Viṣṇu or as supporting the entire world on his head; किं शेषस्य भरव्यथा न वपुषि क्ष्मां न क्षिपत्येष यत्
N. of Balarāma (supposed to be an incarnation of Śeṣa).
Subsidiary अङ्ग; something which is declared as being subservient to something else; शेषः परार्थत्वात्
ŚB.); शेषो हि सादनम् ŚB. on
Favour (प्रसाद); 'शेषः संकर्षणे वधे अनन्ते ना प्रसादे च'
. -षा The remains of flowers or other offerings made to an idol and distributed among the worshippers as a holy relique; तस्यै स्त्रियस्ताः प्रददुः शेषां युयुजुराशिषः
; तथेति शेषामिव भर्तुराज्ञामादाय मूर्ध्ना मदनः प्रतस्थे
; Ś.3.-षम् The remnants of food, remains of an offering. (शेषे is used adverbially in the sense of

in other cases; as in शेषे षष्ठी). -Comp. -अन्नम् leavings of food. -अवस्था old age. -कालः the time of death. -जातिः f. assimilation of residues; (in alg.) reduction of fractions of residues. -पतिः a manager. -भागः the remainder. -भोजनम् the eating of leavings; गृहस्थस्य......त्यागः शेषभोजनम् Kau.
.-रात्रिः the last watch of the night. -रूपिन् a. appearing to be secondary. -शयनः, -शायिन् m. epithets of Viṣṇu.
शेष्य [śēṣya], a. To be ignored, neglected.
सेश्वर [sēśvara], a. Theistical. -Comp. -सांख्यम् the theistical branch of the सांख्य school.
